<p class="lede">The course follows the three parts of <a href="http://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~remzi/OSTEP/">Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces</a>: virtualisation, concurrency and persistence. Each lecture links its slides and its class recording; lectures 15 to 17 were not recorded. Programs shown in class are in the <a href="code/index.html">code folder</a>.</p>
